scope: Public JEV skills and directly relevant tooling discovered during launch week; not an exhaustive or permanent best-of claim.
method: Official docs, skills.sh search, GitHub repository search, two ecosystem indexes; pin repository heads, read skills/READMEs and selected implementation. No hosted CI status used. Stars and installs are discovery signals, not quality proof.

typesafe-ai.note: Conflicting cache snapshots; exact current count not established. Other install counts unknown.

entries.name: Official TypeSafe skill
entries.use_when: Typed question design, SDK integration, and cookbook discovery
entries.assessment: Official, compact guidance; strongest foundation for EA.
entries.verification: Installed from reviewed commit; instructions reviewed. No new transport tested.
entries.limitations: Do not load all live docs; retrieve only the needed cookbook.

entries.name: Jev MCP (Node)
entries.use_when: Evidence verification, candidate ranking, content screening
entries.assessment: Closest reusable companion to EA; existing Cloudflare provider matches our setup.
entries.verification: README and provider implementation inspected; runtime not installed or tested.
entries.limitations: Screening is advisory, not a security boundary. Set provider explicitly; evaluate false negatives.

entries.name: Jev Browser (Codex-oriented)
entries.use_when: Bounded link navigation and prepared browser workflows
entries.assessment: Best skill-shaped match to supervised browser delegation.
entries.verification: Skill and Codex integration inspected; compatibility not proven here.
entries.limitations: Runtime import and automation APIs must be permitted by the current host; no substitution for cua_repl rules.

entries.name: Jev Logs
entries.use_when: Filter which redacted logs merit expensive analysis
entries.assessment: Clear archive-preserving design and protection rules; useful when log volume warrants it.
entries.verification: Skill and README inspected; no live or local runtime tests.
entries.limitations: Not Cloudflare-ready as reviewed. Never drop error/protected logs; benchmark recall as well as cost.

entries.name: Skillbox
entries.use_when: Versioned skill storage and optional semantic recommendations
entries.assessment: Useful reference for a lightweight catalogue and selective loading.
entries.verification: Bootstrap and README inspected; service not deployed.
entries.limitations: Requires its own server/database/auth. Its scan-every-task default may add overhead; do not adopt wholesale.

entries.name: Jev Ultrafast
entries.providers: TypeSafe plus a separate text-generation model
entries.use_when: Indexed browser actions with compact decision requests
entries.assessment: Strong browser-loop reference with explicit measurement limitations.
entries.verification: README and repository tree inspected; benchmark is upstream-reported, not reproduced.
entries.limitations: Not a skill or native iPad controller. Requires a compatible authorized browser runtime.

entries.name: Ask Jev
entries.use_when: Small Choice, Noul, and Score decisions for Hermes
entries.assessment: Lean direct-client example; useful typed-question patterns.
entries.verification: Full skill inspected; not installed or executed.
entries.limitations: Hermes-specific paths, retry policy, and thresholds differ from EA. Confidence cannot authorize destructive work.

entries.name: Eve
entries.use_when: Model routing in agent applications
entries.assessment: Useful for a future app-hosted orchestrator, not a replacement for this desktop session.
entries.verification: Repository metadata and overview retrieved; framework runtime not evaluated.
entries.limitations: Large integration scope. Framework release recency does not prove its JEV feature first shipped that day.

entries.name: Jev Browser MCP
entries.use_when: Delegate browser steps without returning full page snapshots
entries.assessment: Relevant compact-report design; separate from the Codex-oriented project with the same name.
entries.verification: README inspected; upstream task-success claims not reproduced.
entries.limitations: Independent Playwright runner is not automatically allowed in this host; requires integration review.

entries.name: Jev Review MCP
entries.use_when: Score a code change against a rubric
entries.assessment: Potential second signal after deterministic checks.
entries.verification: Skill and README inspected; not installed.
entries.limitations: Mandatory repeated scoring can increase cost and reward score chasing. No automatic review loop.

entries.name: Fast Jev Compaction
entries.use_when: Selectively retain tool calls/results during context compaction; see local compaction guide for comment relevance selection
entries.assessment: High potential context savings, but high integration and information-loss risk.
entries.verification: README, hooks/README.md and hooks/fast-jev.ts inspected at pinned commit; no transcript sent or hook installed.
entries.limitations: Claude Code early-access session.compact hook; default TypeSafe direct adapter, library custom asker. Sends conversation text/tool inputs, concurrent batches lack EA call cap. Not a Codex compaction control or lossless guarantee.

entries.name: Jev Router
entries.providers: JEV provider setup required; verify wrapper configuration
entries.use_when: Per-turn model tier routing for CLI sessions
entries.assessment: Potential cost routing for a dedicated CLI experiment.
entries.verification: README inspected; not enabled.
entries.limitations: Changes how the host is launched; not hot-swappable into this session. Inspect prompt retention and authorization before setup.

entries.name: Jev Codex Router
entries.use_when: Per-turn Codex model selection
entries.assessment: Alternative router to evaluate only if building a separate routing harness.
entries.verification: README inspected; not installed.
entries.limitations: Requires existing Codex Router and session-sharing setup; do not modify credentials or session routing implicitly.

entries.name: TypeSafe MCP (Go)
entries.use_when: General typed evaluate tool in a single binary
entries.assessment: Alternative when a small compiled MCP deployment is preferable.
entries.verification: README inspected; no binary installed.
entries.limitations: Setup can register multiple clients and propagate environment configuration; use explicit manual setup if selected.

entries.name: Jev MCP (Python)
entries.use_when: Classify, score, check, match, screen
entries.assessment: Python alternative; avoid duplicating another JEV toolset.
entries.verification: README inspected; not installed.
entries.limitations: Installer documents writing plaintext credentials into client config; avoid that installation path.

entries.name: Jev Ego
entries.use_when: Indexed actions in ego lite
entries.assessment: Relevant only if ego lite is the chosen browser.
entries.verification: Skill located and README inspected; runtime not tested.
entries.limitations: Different browser dependency; does not justify switching the user’s selected browser.

entries.name: Mobile Jev
entries.use_when: Android device action loops
entries.assessment: Interesting native-device reference, but not our Apple capture stack.
entries.verification: README inspected; no device connection attempted.
entries.limitations: Android only as documented; does not control the user’s iPad or replace Device Hub.

entries.name: Official skill-suggestion cookbook
entries.use_when: Shortlist skills before loading full instructions
entries.assessment: Primary-source implementation pattern; not an installed skill or tool.
entries.verification: Official page inspected; implementation not reproduced.
entries.limitations: Published measurements are source-specific; validate on our workload.
